issues.description: Method name mismatch for the animal feeding-sound operation: the problem statement's Part 3 text and the song example refer to getFeedingSound(), whereas the UML and reference implementation declare and use messageOnFeed(). Specifically, problem_statement.md uses getFeedingSound() in the feedAllAnimals() description and in the song verse placeholders, but solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java declares public abstract String messageOnFeed() and solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java calls animal.messageOnFeed(). This inconsistent naming can confuse students about which method to implement and which name will be used by tests and example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across the exercise materials. Preferred fix: update problem_statement.md to reference messageOnFeed() (replace getFeedingSound() occurrences with messageOnFeed()) so the UML, textual tasks, and examples all use the same identifier. Alternatively, if you prefer getFeedingSound(), rename the abstract method and all calls in the template and solution to getFeedingSound(). Update the examples in the song verse and the feedAllAnimals() description accordingly to avoid student confusion.
